posts.text:
Toh yeh batao, aapne GPT-5.6 ke saath kabhi kabhi kuch problem hai kya? (So, tell me, have you ever faced any issues with GPT-5.6?)
Mujhe ek baar ek customer ke saath interaction hui thi, jab wo poochha tha ki unki refund ka procedure kya hai. (I had an interaction with a customer once, who asked me about the procedure for getting a refund.)
Iske baad maine pata chala ki yeh GPT-5.6 ke accuracy ke liye ek important parameter hai. (After that, I found out that this is an important parameter for GPT-5.6's accuracy.)
Agar aap bhi GPT-5.6 ke saath interaction karte hue aise sawal poochte hain, toh aapko bhi yeh parameter dhyan mein rakhna chahiye. (If you too ask such questions while interacting with GPT-5.6, then you should also keep this parameter in mind.)
Lekin aapko yaad rakhna chahiye, accuracy toh ek baat hai, lekin consistency bhi ek bada ullas hai. (But remember, accuracy is one thing, consistency is another great thing.)
Ab aapko OpenAI ne ek aur update diya hai, jismein GPT-5.6 Sol ka better accuracy aur consistency hai, aur GPT-5.6 Luna ke liye free users ke liye unlimited everyday chats ka access bhi mila hai. (Now, OpenAI has given you another update, which has better accuracy and consistency for GPT-5.6 Sol, and also provides free users with unlimited everyday chats with GPT-5.6 Luna.)

Source: https://openai.com/index/improving-gpt-5-6-sol-in-chatgpt
posts.text_en:
I deleted ChatGPT's old Sol last week. It wasn't a hard decision.

The new GPT-5.6 Sol is more accurate, more consistent. It's not just a minor tweak. It's a significant improvement.

But the real game-changer? Expanded access to GPT-5.6 Luna for free users.

You heard that right. Unlimited everyday chats with a powerful model that used to be exclusive to paid users.

Now, I know what you're thinking. "But what about the cost?"

Cost isn't the problem here. Access is.

OpenAI understands this. They're making their most advanced technology available to more people.

It's not a marketing gimmick. It's a commitment to democratizing AI.

And it's not just about the numbers. The new Luna model is designed for everyday use. It's not just for power users or tech enthusiasts. It's for anyone who wants to explore the possibilities of AI.

The improved Sol and expanded access to Luna are a win for everyone. For users, it means better interactions and more opportunities to learn and explore. For OpenAI, it means more engagement and more opportunities to refine their models.

So, next time you chat with ChatGPT, remember, you're not just interacting with a machine. You're part of a community pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI.

Source: https://openai.com/index/improving-gpt-5-6-sol-in-chatgpt
